name: Cost Management Plan
notes: Units of Measure, Level of Precision and Level of Accuracy print as three boxes side by side on one row, each label in a header strip above its box, so that entry in pairs has three members, left to right (as in 2.11). The prose table (Table 2.17) says 'Cost reporting information and format'; the blank form prints 'Cost Reporting and Format', which wins.
